en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1915 - Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)
about a man who sees the crescent for the Month of Ramadan alone, and no one else sees it. Should he fast?
Imam (as) said: "If he has no doubt, let him break his fast. Otherwise, let him fast with the people."
